2026-06-25.en: Dewdrops await the dawn upon blades of grass.
2026-06-25.zh: 露珠在草叶上等待黎明。

2026-06-26.en: Longing is a letter without an address.

2026-06-27.en: Great people do things before they are ready.
2026-06-27.zh: 伟大的人在准备好前就行动。

2026-06-28.en: To succeed, want success more than you fear failure.
2026-06-28.zh: 渴望成功胜过害怕失败，方能成功。

2026-06-29.en: The radio crackles with hoarse memories.
2026-06-29.zh: 收音机发出沙哑的回忆。

2026-06-30.en: Stamps are tickets to distant lands.

2026-07-01.en: Focus on the present, not the past or future.
2026-07-01.zh: 不念过往，不畏将来，专注当下。

2026-07-02.en: Every raindrop falls from the clouds above.
2026-07-02.zh: 每一滴雨，都从云层里落下来。

2026-07-03.en: Light bulbs are like fruits that light up the night.
2026-07-03.zh: 灯泡像黑夜里结出的果实。

2026-07-04.en: Silence is the most perfect expression of scorn.
2026-07-04.zh: 沉默是轻蔑最完美的表达。

2026-07-05.en: No matter how long the rain lasts, there will be a rainbow.
2026-07-05.zh: 无论雨下多久，终见彩虹。

2026-07-06.en: Life is a question and how we live it is our answer.
2026-07-06.zh: 生活是一个问题，我们如何生活是我们的答案。

2026-07-07.en: Don’t burn bridges. A wide network provides support.
2026-07-07.zh: 别自断后路，广阔人脉网提供前进资源。

2026-07-08.en: All advantages aren't in running quickly, but in getting a head start.​
2026-07-08.zh: 优势不在于跑得快，而在于起身早。

2026-07-09.en: Stay curious, and the world stays fresh.
2026-07-09.zh: 保持好奇，世界永远新鲜。

2026-07-10.en: You are becoming the person you are meant to be.
2026-07-10.zh: 你正在成为你该成为的人。

2026-07-12.en: Though beaten and battered, stay strong against all winds.
2026-07-12.zh: 千磨万击还坚劲，任尔东西南北风。

2026-07-13.en: Patience is not just waiting. It makes us stronger.
2026-07-13.zh: 耐心不是干等，而是在等待里变强。

2026-07-14.en: Living a meaningful life is a great achievement.
2026-07-14.zh: 过有意义的生活，就是伟大的成就。

2026-07-15.en: Not too much, not too little — just enough.

2026-07-17.en: Trust is the gentle care we give each other.
2026-07-17.zh: 信任，是彼此愿意给出的温柔。

2026-07-19.en: There is no garden without weeds.

2026-07-20.en: True strength is standing up again after we fall.
2026-07-20.zh: 真正的强大，是跌倒后再站起来。

2026-07-21.en: Calm is the quiet deep place in a lake.
2026-07-21.zh: 平静，像湖水最深处的安静。

2026-07-22.en: In conflict, the heart seems to speak with two voices.
2026-07-22.zh: 矛盾时，心里像有两个声音在说话。

2026-07-23.en: Heat rolls in, but watermelon tastes just right.
2026-07-23.zh: 热浪滚滚，但西瓜甜得正好。

2026-07-24.en: Friends by our side make the road feel shorter.

2026-07-25.en: Pains make stronger, tears make braver,and heartbreaks make wiser.
2026-07-25.zh: 伤痛铸坚强，眼泪淬勇敢，心碎炼智慧。

2026-07-26.en: Dripping water pierces stone—not by force, but persistence.
2026-07-26.zh: 滴水穿石，非力使然，恒也。

2026-07-27.en: Kind words can gently hold a hurting heart.
2026-07-27.zh: 安慰的话，能轻轻扶住受伤的心。

2026-07-28.en: Habit is like a path that leads us forward.
2026-07-28.zh: 习惯像一条路，引着我们往前走。

2026-07-29.en: Waiting turns time into something sweet.

2026-07-30.en: A chance meeting is candy from fate.

2026-07-31.en: At goodbye, even a full suitcase cannot hold all our cares.
2026-07-31.zh: 离别时，行李箱再满，也装不下全部牵挂。

2026-08-01.en: Your silent march through storms writes peace upon our land.
2026-08-01.zh: 你穿越风暴的无声行进，在大地写下和平。

2026-08-02.en: To be human is to hold sovereignty over one's fate.​
2026-08-02.zh: 为人之本，在于对命运的掌控。

2026-08-03.en: Keep your eyes on the stars and your feet on the ground.

2026-08-04.en: A lazy youth, a lousy age.
2026-08-04.zh: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲。

2026-08-06.en: One swallow does not make a summer.
2026-08-06.zh: 一燕不成夏（一花独放不是春）。

2026-08-10.en: Love looks not with the eyes, but with the mind.
2026-08-10.zh: 爱情不用眼睛看，而用心灵看。

2026-08-11.en: Morning light makes its way through half-drawn curtains.
2026-08-11.zh: 晨光穿过半掩的窗帘，慢慢进来。

2026-08-12.en: Kindness costs little, yet it changes the whole room.
2026-08-12.zh: 善意花费很少，却能改变整个房间。

2026-08-13.en: Warm tea on a quiet night softens a hard day.
2026-08-13.zh: 安静夜里的热茶，能软化艰难的一天。

2026-08-14.en: Let today be enough; tomorrow can wait a while.
2026-08-14.zh: 让今天就够了，明天可以再等等。
